skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks about drug/medication information, wants to look up drug instructions, side effects, dosage, indications, or needs a drug instruction manual link. It calls the ADP LLMQueryDrugInstructions API, which takes a drug-related question and returns structured drug information including drug name, trade name, manufacturer, specification, usage, indications, adverse reactions, and instruction manual links. Triggers include: user asks about a specific drug like '布洛芬怎么吃', '阿莫西林的副作用', '头孢的用法用量', '对乙酰氨基酚说明书', '这个药能和那个药一起吃吗'; or general drug queries like '退烧药有哪些', '消炎药推荐', '止痛药的注意事项'. Does NOT trigger for: symptom analysis or health diagnosis (use tencentcloud-adp-diagnosis instead), non-drug health questions ('我头疼怎么办' → use diagnosis skill), or drug purchasing/pricing questions.

skills.description_zh:
app-i18n-l10n 是一个面向移动 App 的 Cursor / Claude Agent Skill，帮你端到端增加新语言版本。
在 Cursor 里安装后，对 Agent 说一句「帮我增加日语版本」，它会自动完成：
1. 应用内本地化 — 审计 xcstrings、InfoPlist、硬编码字符串；写入翻译；接入语言切换与 Xcode 配置
2. 商店上架物料 — 生成 App Store Connect 元数据（标题、副标题、描述、关键词等）及宣传截图文案，并按字符上限校验
3. 运行时踩坑检查 — 检测 UserDefaults 存展示文案、SwiftUI 切换语言不刷新等常见问题
